biography.oneLiner: MAN1K makes music the way a séance is run — deliberately, in the dark, expecting something to answer back.
biography.short: MAN1K is a Ukrainian witch house producer and DJ active since February 2023. Shaped on the club floors of Kumamoto, Japan and now performing across Europe and Ukraine, the project carries 30,000+ streams, Amazing Radio airplay, and sets across 10+ cities in 3 countries.
biography.medium: MAN1K (Yaroslav Boruk) is a Ukrainian Witch House producer and DJ active since February 2023. Emerging from Khmelnytskyi, Ukraine and shaped into its current form on the club floors of Kumamoto, Japan, the project sits at the intersection of witch house tradition and physical live ceremony. He has organized landmark underground events in Japan, performed at Sala Pirandello in Madrid, received airplay on Amazing Radio, and in 2026 led the Wild Heart Tour — 10 shows across 8 Ukrainian cities, the largest tour Ukraine's dark electronic scene has staged to date. Represented in Europe by ElektroSpank Agency.
biography.long:
Emerging from Khmelnytskyi, Ukraine in February 2023 and shaped into its current form on the club floors of Kumamoto, Japan, the project sits at the crossing point of witch house tradition — a genre that was born online and rarely asked to survive a room full of bodies. MAN1K builds productions out of heavy reverb, pitched vocals, and layered synthesis that favor atmosphere over structure: tracks engineered for the narrow space between dissociation and ritual tension.

Live, that same tension turns physical. A MAN1K set is staged as ceremony: slow and incantatory one moment, kinetic the next, with the audience treated as participant rather than crowd. Since 2023, that approach has carried the project across three countries — from Ukraine's underground basements to HVEN in Tokyo and Sala Pirandello in Madrid — and into 2026 as the architect of the Wild Heart Tour, the largest tour Ukraine's dark electronic scene has staged to date.

Each release refuses the false choice between darkness and beauty, aggression and vulnerability — building sonic landscapes where the full emotional register runs at once.

faq.name: Who is MAN1K?

acceptedAnswer.text: MAN1K is a Ukrainian Witch House music producer and DJ born in Khmelnytskyi, Ukraine. Active since February 2023, shaped on the club floors of Kumamoto, Japan and now based in Europe. He has received Amazing Radio airplay, 30,000+ streams across DSPs, performed in 10+ cities across 3 countries, and in 2026 led the Wild Heart Tour — the largest dark electronic tour in Ukraine's underground history.

faq.name: What genre is MAN1K?

acceptedAnswer.text: MAN1K's primary genre is Witch House (specifically Modern Witch House) — a microgenre of electronic music combining lo-fi beats, dark atmospheres, pitched vocals, and occult aesthetics.

faq.name: Where is MAN1K from?

acceptedAnswer.text: MAN1K is from Khmelnytskyi, Ukraine. He lived and built his sound in Kumamoto, Japan from 2023 to 2025 and is currently based in Europe.

faq.name: Where can I listen to MAN1K?

acceptedAnswer.text: MAN1K's music is available on all major streaming platforms including Spotify, Apple Music, SoundCloud, Bandcamp, Tidal, Deezer, and Amazon Music.

faq.name: How do I book MAN1K for an event?

acceptedAnswer.text: EU/international booking: ElektroSpank Agency at mgmt@pr.elektrospank.com. Ukraine booking: Alexander at sasha1924181999@gmail.com. General inquiries: void@man1k.xyz.

faq.name: Has MAN1K been on radio?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. MAN1K's music has received 40+ rotations on Amazing Radio (UK and USA) with the debut single, and also appeared on Hot Wax Radio and RadioLDN.

faq.name: What is Witch House music?

acceptedAnswer.text: Witch House is a microgenre of electronic music that emerged around 2009, combining lo-fi hip-hop beats, shoegaze textures, chopped and screwed vocals, and occult/horror aesthetics. It typically features slow, heavy beats with dark, reverb-drenched atmospheres.

faq.name: What is MAN1K's real name?

acceptedAnswer.text: MAN1K's real name is Yaroslav Boruk.

faq.name: What is УВХР / UWHR?

acceptedAnswer.text: #UWHR (#УВХР) stands for the Ukrainian Witch House Movement (Український Вітч Хаус Рух), administered by MAN1K to promote and unite Ukrainian witch house artists and culture.

faq.name: When did MAN1K start making music?

acceptedAnswer.text: MAN1K began producing music in February 2023, based in Kumamoto, Japan.

faq.name: Is MAN1K a solo project or a collective?

acceptedAnswer.text: MAN1K is a solo project. The artist also performs as part of DeadRay (with producer DesireLust and vocalist Lakomi), formed in 2025.

faq.name: What languages does MAN1K speak?

acceptedAnswer.text: MAN1K communicates in Ukrainian, Russian, English, and Japanese.

faq.name: Is MAN1K politically or socially engaged?

acceptedAnswer.text: MAN1K actively supports Ukrainian underground culture through event organizing, community building, and administrating the Ukrainian Witch House Movement (#UWHR).

faq.name: Does MAN1K perform live or only DJ sets?

acceptedAnswer.text: MAN1K performs DJ sets and live sets. Each performance is staged as ceremony, not entertainment — slow and incantatory one moment, kinetic the next.

faq.name: Is Witch House a dead genre?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Witch House continues to evolve through underground scenes, new artists, and hybrid substyles. MAN1K is part of a growing Ukrainian witch house movement and helped establish the genre's physical presence in Japan.

faq.name: Does MAN1K release music regularly?

acceptedAnswer.text: MAN1K follows a quality-first release strategy rather than fixed release schedules.

faq.name: Is MAN1K a real person or a fictional character?

acceptedAnswer.text: MAN1K is a real Ukrainian music producer and DJ performing under a conceptual artistic identity.

faq.name: Is MAN1K's personal life public?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. MAN1K keeps personal life strictly private. Only information related to artistic work, public performances, and professional activity is publicly available.

faq.name: What professional roles does MAN1K combine?

acceptedAnswer.text: MAN1K operates as a producer, DJ, event organizer, and underground scene builder.

faq.name: Does MAN1K participate in cultural archiving of Witch House?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. MAN1K is documented in the Japanese and Ukrainian Wikipedia entries on witch house, and was the first artist from Khmelnytskyi to be recorded in the Library of Congress.

faq.name: Why does MAN1K perform in a mask or concealed appearance?

acceptedAnswer.text: The mask is part of MAN1K's artistic identity. It emphasizes the ritualistic and ceremonial nature of the performance, and separates the private individual from the public artistic entity.

faq.name: Is MAN1K connected to any religion or occult organization?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. The visual imagery are artistic symbols used for atmosphere and narrative, not indicators of any real-life religious or organizational affiliation.

faq.name: Does MAN1K have merch?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, official MAN1K merchandise is available at shop.man1k.xyz. Support: contact@support.shop.man1k.xyz.

faq.name: What was the Wild Heart Tour?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Wild Heart Tour (2026) was a 10-show, 8-city tour across Ukraine — staged in partnership with VICHNA NICH and #UWHR with 20+ support artists. It was the first tour of its scale for Ukraine's dark electronic underground.

acceptedAnswer.text: For legal inquiries contact legal@man1k.xyz.
